title: SEC3: Manual URL parsing in discovery.rs instead of url crate
description: discovery.rs lines 195-248: extract_mailbox_host() does manual RFC 3986 URL parsing (scheme stripping, IPv6 bracket handling, port parsing, port 443 omission). This reimplements what url::Url can do in 3 lines. Current implementation is correct but fragile — comprehensive test suite (357-413) exists precisely because manual parsing is complex. Better: use url::Url::parse(), host_str(), and conditionally include port based on scheme default. Reduces lines of code, eliminates parse edge cases, reuses a vetted RFC 3986 implementation.
